**The problem**
What are you trying to do that the app makes hard or impossible today?

**Proposed solution**
How you imagine it working. Screenshots or sketches welcome.

**Scope check**
This project stays a simple, single-user, local-first tool (see
CONTRIBUTING.md). Features that add accounts, servers, or LinkedIn
automation (auto-sending, auto-connecting) are out of scope. If your idea
touches those, say why it still fits.

**Alternatives considered**
Anything you tried or thought about instead.
